Theorem
[Normal Codazzi--Mainardi equation]

Source: petersen:page-0111 ↗ thm:pet-ch3-tangential-curvature-equation

1. ch3:3.2.5For $X,Y,Z$ tangent to a hypersurface $H$, \[ g(R(X,Y)Z,N)=-( abla _X\Pi )(Y,Z)+( abla _Y\Pi )(X,Z). \]
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch3-normal-curvature-equation \sketch In the tangent-normal expansion used for the Gauss equation, the normal coefficient is $-( abla _X\Pi )(Y,Z)+( abla _Y\Pi )(X,Z)$. Pairing with the unit normal $N$ gives the formula.
